$comment: The skills library index. scripts/check-library.sh verifies every entry against the files on disk, and scripts/spawn.sh reads `needs` and `default_for` to pick what a new project gets. `needs` are the answers of the questionnaire in docs/questionnaire.md. `default_for` names repo kinds whose presence installs the entry without being asked.

needs.prose: every session writes prose: commit messages, docs, replies
needs.self-improvement: friction noticed during work becomes a skill candidate
needs.discovery: search the open skills ecosystem for what is missing
needs.code-quality: a simplification pass on every diff
needs.security: pattern check on every edit, review of every diff and commit
needs.skill-authoring: write or evaluate skills of your own
needs.browser-testing: drive a local web app with playwright-cli
needs.ui: static UI guidance: style, color, type, layout
needs.ui-review: a merge gate on UI code: accessibility, focus, forms, performance
needs.components: one library per UI task, each pick a recorded decision
needs.motion: animation and interaction, plus a merge gate for it
needs.conversion: audit a page or form that already exists
needs.activation: the path from paid to first value
needs.experiments: design an A/B test before a change ships as one

entries.name: stop-slop
entries.summary: Removes AI writing patterns from every piece of prose.

entries.name: task-observer
entries.summary: Watches each session for corrections and methodology worth keeping as skills. Log pinned inside the repo because the container is ephemeral.

entries.name: find-skills
entries.summary: Finds installable skills for a need nothing here covers. skills.sh is blocked from the web container; search GitHub instead.

entries.name: mem
entries.summary: Hierarchical memory at .claude/memory/, committed to git.

entries.name: code-simplifier
entries.summary: Simplification pass on every code change before commit. Invoked as an agent, never loaded as a skill.
entries.local_change_note: The 'Apply Project Standards' list points at each repo's CLAUDE.md instead of another project's conventions.

entries.name: security-guidance
entries.summary: Pattern check on every edit, model review of the diff at the end of every turn, agentic review on every commit and push. Its repo rules are the two harness files.

entries.name: ui-ux-pro-max
entries.summary: The single source of static UI guidance. Do not enable a second one (frontend-design, taste-skill): two advisors on one task produce two aesthetics.

entries.name: web-design-guidelines
entries.summary: Merge gate on any site or app pull request that touches UI: about 100 rules on accessibility, focus, forms, performance and i18n, checked in code, findings as file:line. Rules vendored in command.md, never fetched.
entries.local_change_note: Addendum: read command.md instead of fetching; accessibility, focus, forms and anti-pattern findings block; review-animations, BRAND.md and ui-ux-pro-max keep their domains.

entries.name: pick-ui-library
entries.summary: Picks one library per UI task (primitives, toasts, command menu, charts, virtualization, drag and drop, state). disable-model-invocation upstream, so Claude reads it by path; animate sends component work here.
entries.local_change_note: Addendum: a pick is a decision line before install; React picks go to the app; next-themes skipped; motion rows go through animate.

entries.name: skill-creator
entries.summary: Create, edit and evaluate skills. Needs python3.

entries.name: playwright-cli
entries.summary: Drives a local web app from the shell: open, click, type, snapshot with element refs, screenshots, traces, video, request mocking, test generation. Node, no script to write.
entries.local_change_note: Addendum on the web container: pinned 0.1.22 installed by the setup script, Chromium at /opt/pw-browsers/chromium passed on open, output in /tmp, serve over http, no gh for attachments.

entries.name: animate
entries.summary: Builds motion and interaction. Pairs with review-animations.
entries.local_change_note: Addendum: ui-ux-pro-max owns static UI; sample curves are examples, not tokens; an animation library is a recorded decision.

entries.name: review-animations
entries.summary: Merge gate on any site or app pull request that touches motion. disable-model-invocation upstream, so Claude reads it by path; a Block verdict stops the merge.
entries.local_change_note: Addendum: when it runs, Tailwind default durations and easings accepted until motion tokens exist, motion only.

entries.name: cro
entries.summary: Audits a page or form that already exists. Form CRO is a reference inside it.

entries.name: onboarding
entries.summary: A customer's path from paid to first value.

entries.name: ab-testing
entries.summary: Designs an experiment before a change ships as a test.
